instruction.text: <mat>3/20</mat> of the sheep in Cinderbirt are brown. Write the proportion of brown sheep as a decimal.
<mat>18%</mat> of the sheep in Thornshire are brown. Which county has the larger proportion of brown sheep?
Dylan pours out <mat>32%</mat> of the water in his glass. Write the remaining proportion of water in the glass as a decimal.
After Jonah drinks from his glass of water, it is <mat>3/4</mat> full. Who has more water left, Dylan or Jonah?
A shirt is discounted by <mat>30%</mat>. Write the percentage discount as a fraction.
A second shirt is discounted to <mat>0.8</mat> of its original price. Which shirt has the higher discount?
